### 2026-10-07 – I downloaded KiCad, used a template for a Pi HAT and an Esp32 S3 and worked a ton on it and mostly labeled things. I worked a ton on the boot and reset circuits with power buttons and stuff. It was re

**1h**

I downloaded KiCad, used a template for a Pi HAT and an Esp32 S3 and worked a ton on it and mostly labeled things. I worked a ton on the boot and reset circuits with power buttons and stuff. It was really cool. I think I'm doing good and soon enough I will be done, slowly but surely. I also labeled the TX and RX for connecting the ESP32 S3 to the Pi.
